title: Parameter - Body - Blocks SpaceDoubleQuotes
description: The parameter is echoed in the BODY tag, but any request containing space, double quotes is filtered.
php:
Parameter - Body (Blocks Spaces & Double Quotes)

Spaces and double quotes (") are stripped from your input before reflection.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Filtered reflected output:
objectives: Construct a payload without spaces or double quotes.
Use forward slashes / or alternative delimiters to separate attributes.
hints: Spaces and double quotes are removed.
Use slashes inside HTML tags: <svg/onload=alert(1)> or <script>alert(1)</script>.
